claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For two disjoint affine-coset defect pieces at physical Hamming distance at least two in one negative selector slice, with no Fourier-orthogonality assumption, the signed associator satisfies Omega<=16 ln(2) I(d).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.statement: For disjoint real functions u,v with total squared norm at most one, E(u+v)<=2E(u)+2E(v)+(||u||_2^2+||v||_2^2)/e; the stated coefficientwise form holds without spectral orthogonality.

claims.label: CONDITIONAL_CLASS_THEOREM
claims.statement: Adaptive nonreusing hierarchies of the separated two-coset local pieces obey sum_v w_v Omega_v<=16 ln(2) I(b) when the local sources are restrictions of one physical source b.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: For adjacent coset pieces the negative derivative cross term reduces source influence; no matching entropy-collision refund or single-use terminal boundary reserve is yet proved.
